QuestInfo.name: Kingdom Under Attack
QuestInfo.0: On the day of the raid, Alpha and Beta headed back to #b#p2420010##k to see what he was planning.
QuestInfo.1: The Sand Bandits had a simple plan in mind to enter the castle. An agent inside the castle would secure a hidden path in, and the Sand Bandits would use Phantom's robbery as a distraction to enter the treasure vault and start a fire. Alpha and Beta were set to be the lookouts... \r\n\r\n#r(Tip: Forfeit the quest to restart.)
QuestInfo.2: #p2400005# and #p2400006#'s plan to capture the jewel was foiled when Phantom struck before the Sand Bandits could arrive... But all was not lost. The duo discovered the truth: #b#p2420000##k is the real Goddess Teardrop!
